review_evidence: README identifies ProvenZK as a library for Lean-based analysis and verification of zero-knowledge circuits, including circuits extracted from gnark.
ProvenZk/Binary.lean proves bit/vector encodings, decomposition and round-trip/injectivity properties such as toBitsBE_ofBitsBE_eq_self and ofBitsBE_toBitsBE_eq_self.

The 14 formal modules also cover gates, hashes, Merkle constructions, unique assignments, matrices and vectors; the unit-wide declaration scan found about 184 definitions/theorems/lemmas, well beyond implementation-only code.
summary: Retain proven-zk: it contains reusable definitions and correctness lemmas for Lean-based verification of zero-knowledge circuits.
